thread:
sylvia: Quick sync — we need a minimal, unambiguous error taxonomy for the API launch. Can we lock codes + fallback behavior today?

mike: +1. Constraints: must be implementable in hosted + dedicated + private. Keep payload tiny.

sylvia: Right. Goals: actionable client guidance (retry vs fail), clear observability keys (request id, hint), per-endpoint notes (embeddings vs chat).

raj: Draft mapping idea: short list only. Will post snippet.

raj: ```
400 -> validation_error (client fix)
401 -> unauthorized
403 -> forbidden
404 -> not_found
409 -> conflict (e.g., incompatible params)
429 -> rate_limit_exceeded (retryable, use Retry-After)
503 -> model_unavailable (retryable or fallback to smaller model)
500 -> internal_error (non-retryable, include trace_id)
```

nina: Love concise set. A few edge cases: structured-output endpoints may need a specific schema_validation error separate from generic validation_error. Also embeddings should surface quotas differently.

mike: Suggest a header: `X-Redwood-Request-ID` + `X-Redwood-Error-Code` (machine-readable string). Keep human message in `message`.

sam: From support: customers want deterministic behavior for model_unavailable — if we say fallback, doc the quality delta and opt-out via `prefer_no_fallback=true`. Also surface which fallback model was used in response.

raj: Agree. Update mapping: add codes as strings in header. e.g., `X-Redwood-Error-Code: model_unavailable` and body: { "error": { "code": "model_unavailable", "message": "primary model out of capacity, falling back to x-small-1", "fallback": "x-small-1", "retryable": true } }

infra-bot: deploy: canary rollout v1.2 error-mapping update started — will log metrics to #eng-metrics.

mike: Launch criteria proposal:
- All endpoints return one of the canonical codes above
- 95th percentile of customer-visible retryable errors < 0.5% in canary
- Observability: every error includes request_id + error_code in logs
- Docs: clear client guidance for retry/backoff and opt-out flags

sylvia: Add SLA negotiation note: for enterprise customers we allow customizing rate-limit thresholds and explicit non-fallback policies. Need product owner sign-off for scope.

nina: Implementation note: For private deployments, we expose a config map: `error_handling.fallback_policy` and `rate_limit.policy` so infra teams can tune. Add auditlog requirement.

sam: Also need a short FAQ entry for common customer asks: why 429 vs 503, what to do on validation_error, how to request increased quota.

mike: One more: retry semantics. We should standardize: for 429 -> recommend exponential backoff with jitter, max retries 5. For 503 model_unavailable -> client may retry with jitter but prefer fallback path first.

raj: For ML endpoints: add `error.subtype` when relevant, e.g., `error.subtype: kv_cache_evicted` or `error.subtype: seq_len_exceeded`. Helpful for runbooks.

sylvia: OK action items:
- raj: update spec + code snippet for headers + body (by EOD)
- mike: ensure SDKs map numeric -> enums and expose fallback opt-out (tomorrow)
- nina: docs + config for private (two days)
- sam: draft support FAQ (tomorrow)
- infra-bot: collect canary metrics and post summary at last_message_ts

sylvia: If no objections, I'll mark this as the canonical minimal taxonomy for M1 launch. :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

sam: one tiny nit — include `Retry-After` header whenever we instruct retry.

raj: added in snippet.

sylvia: Great — merging these into the PR. Will ping legal/saas for SLA template.
